Cinder makes handmade ceramic cups. Our personality is warm and practical. Our positioning is useful handmade ceramics for daily coffee rituals. Our audience is home espresso enthusiasts. Our tone is clear and calm. Our values are care and durability. Our key message is: A considered cup for your coffee pause. Our brand colors are navy #123456 and cream #FFF8E7. Our visual guidelines require natural daylight and uncluttered backgrounds.
